recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-3315 unless a separate current issue changes `_filter` semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search issue asking for a standard convention for logical operators in query strings; the accepted resolution was to introduce the `_filter` search parameter.
initial_application: FHIR-3315 comments say `_filter` had been added through a different task and point to the historical search_filter page. FHIR-3032 is that companion task: its comments record the decision to document `_filter` and cite svn revision 3109, which maps to October 2014 commits 4c415967c8c8615773dd33fa0b0e7071acc1f864 and 475656e5d227373206b99ce4adc24fb5308b5f36 adding the Search page advanced-filtering section and `source/search_filter.html`.
additional_context: Current source still contains `_filter` in the active search narrative: `source/search.html` introduces Advanced filtering and lists `_filter` as a special common parameter, `source/search_filter.html` defines the syntax, logical expressions, grammar, and comparison operators, and `source/exchanging.html` describes `_filter` as supporting nested logical expressions. Searches found no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion and no later conflict with this decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current specification already includes the accepted `_filter` mechanism and operator/logical-expression guidance.
